summary: A 1952 lookout on Moores Hill in the D.A.R. State Forest, Goshen, Massachusetts. Staffed seasonally and open to visitors, with repairs reported in 2020.

access.note: Public state forest. The register records an undated closure for dam renovations and a back-road route; check current DCR notices before visiting.

visit.trail_note: Mass.gov lists the DAR Fire Tower as a hiking destination in the forest.

facts.agency: Massachusetts Department of Conservation and Recreation (DCR)

events.note: Goshen lookout constructed on Moores Hill in the D.A.R. State Forest
Registered on the National Historic Lookout Register, December 15, 2004
Trip report describes a DCR crew making repairs to the tower on September 24, 2020
Gazette reports DCR planned seasonal lookout staffing, with Goshen among the key towers

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register's closure comment has no date of its own and sits beside an April 2016 photo. The 2020 trip report and the current Mass.gov page both show the tower open to visitors.

notes_for_editor: Height and cab design are unconfirmed. A search snippet from the FFLA Massachusetts chapter gives 68 ft, but the Facebook post could not be read, so it is not used. The register names the older Bureau of Forest Fire Control as administrator; the 2023 Gazette names DCR, so agency is set to DCR and the record's agency field may need updating. Staffing: the register's 'Staffed seasonally' note is undated; the 2023 staffing item is a plan. The closure comment is undated (photo April 2016), so current access should be confirmed. Climbing rests on one 2020 trip report. No fire credited to this tower was found. The Eastern US Lookouts Moores Hill page yielded only navigation text.
